fields.acceptance: A testscript (go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<its name>) opens a change set with change new --workflow, shows the workflow in change show --json, shows run start --dry-run picking it, shows an unknown name refused, and folds with fold-ok
fields.statement: rhiza change new --workflow <name> opens a change set pinned to that workflow, recorded as a request's workflow is, so its ready pick is that workflow; a name that does not resolve is refused as rhiza request --workflow refuses it

fields.acceptance: A testscript pins a draft change set to a workflow and shows change show --json and run start --dry-run picking it, clears it back to the dispatch rules, refuses an unknown name and a landed change set, and folds with fold-ok; internal/api tests cover the operation
fields.statement: A command pins or clears the workflow of an existing change set that has not landed and has no live run (for example rhiza change workflow <name> | --clear), so a change set opened by a milestone plan can be built with a chosen workflow

fields.acceptance: rhiza workflow check docs passes, rhiza workflow describe docs shows signoff owner, change show --json of each of the three page change sets shows workflow docs, and make self-check passes
fields.statement: This repo has a workflow named docs (.rhiza/workflows/docs.toml, forked from ship-change) whose autonomy sets signoff = owner, whose builder and fixer prompts write doc prose with the owner's humanize skill under constraints doc-prose-humanized and doc-examples-plain-commands, and the milestone's three page change sets (README and quickstart polish, Concepts polish, Agents and runs docs polish) are pinned to it
